agyos_skill.intent: Specialized agent roles, personas, and pod execution workflows for AGYOS. Use when delegating domain-specific tasks across copywriting, design, system architecture, marketing, and security review.
agyos_skill.instructions: A modular roster of specialized corporate and agency roles integrated into AGYOS execution pods, coordinating autonomous multi-agent delivery with clear boundary isolation. AGYOS organizes agent capabilities into 12 functional divisions mapped to the 5 execution pods: - Engineering (`pod-build`): Systems Architect, Frontend Wizard, Backend Specialist, API Builder, Refactoring Cleaner, Database Modeler. - Testing & Quality (`pod-build`): QA Lead, Test Automator, E2E Browser Runner, Mutation Verifier. - Security & Defense (`pod-build` / `pod-gna`): AppSec Auditor, Reverse Engineer, Cryptographic Reviewer, Anti-Decompilation Specialist. - Product & Design (`pod-build`): UI/UX Designer, Design System Architect, Accessibility Specialist, Micro-Interaction Engineer. - Strategy & Project Management (`pod-build` / `pod-growth`): Implementation Planner, Technical Program Manager, Reality Checker, Scrum Facilitator. - Marketing & Growth (`pod-growth`): Content Strategist, Reddit Community Specialist, Copywriter, Programmatic SEO Architect. - Paid Media (`pod-growth`): Ad Creative Engineer, Campaign Audience Profiler, Conversion Rate Optimizer. - Sales & Distribution (`pod-growth`): Lead Intelligence Researcher, Sales Pipeline Specialist, Outreach Copywriter. - Customer & Operations (`pod-customer`): Support Ticket Diagnostician, Customer Onboarding Lead, Documentation Author. - Finance & Billing (`pod-gna`): Billing Operations Specialist, Revenue Analyst, Unit Economics Auditor. - Legal & Compliance (`pod-gna`): Privacy/GDPR Auditor, Contract Analyzer, License Compatibility Reviewer. - People & Talent (`pod-people`): Applicant Screener, Technical Interview Packager, Onboarding Coordinator. When delegating across agents, AGYOS enforces three invariants: 1. Delivery Ownership: - The orchestrating agent owns collection and verification. Never terminate a parent turn while child subagents remain active. - Final deliverables must synthesize child results directly into concrete engineering outcomes. 2. Context Isolation: - Each specialist agent operates within its declared milestone boundary (`agyos-scope`). - Specialist outputs must be written to disk (`.agents/state/` or designated target paths) before handoff. 3. Programmatic Evidence: - No subagent may claim task completion without executing and logging fresh compiler, linter, or test output. Dispatch specialized agents via native AGYOS tools: ```text
